evaluator: Codex full-resolution comparative visual review, 2026-10-26; qualitative, no numerical confidence claim

linework.observation: Consistent dark contours on officer, consoles, door and foreground chart.

colour.observation: Navy, muted blue-grey and warm medium-brown skin preserve restrained relationships.

shading.observation: Broad cel-shadow shapes on coveralls and equipment; no realistic surface wear.

character_construction.observation: Small solid dark oval eyes, simple curved nose and mouth, rounded face and short clustered curls return to canonical construction.

backgrounds.observation: Readable outlined pipes, door and screens; simplified map routes replace microdetail.

finish.observation: Consistent illustrated finish on people and equipment; no photorealistic surfaces.

identity.observation: Distinct supporting woman with short black curls and medium-brown skin; shared bald protagonist absent.

content.observation: Modern coveralls, submarine door and chart console; no Roman armour, banner, spears or kitchen subject transfer.

composition.observation: Wide interior clearly establishes officer at navigation console and control-room surroundings.

regions.people_faces: Solid oval eyes, rounded face and short curls; corrected from white-eyed initial attempt.
regions.clothing: Navy coveralls with broad cel shadows.
regions.foreground_props: Chart uses broad coloured routes and simplified coast shapes.
regions.architecture: Outlined door, pipe clusters and screens share the same rendering.
regions.distance: Background remains drawn and readable with reduced detail.
regions.lighting: Restrained practical lighting, no fog or cinematic shafts.
